mechanism: A unit of epistemic {{state}}. Represents a claim held by an {{agent}} with a specific confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) and a pointer to supporting evidence. Unlike a Fact, a Belief is subjective and mutable.
gloss: A subjective claim with confidence and evidence

parameters.name: confidence
parameters.description: Subjective probability that this belief is true

parameters.name: evidence
parameters.description: Supporting evidence contexts for this belief

proposition.description: The claim held by the agent

supporting_evidence.description: IDs of observations supporting this belief

provenance.description: Source of the belief (Inference, Axiom, Observation)
